api_analysis.hypothesis: The missing kernels/*_binding.cpp causes the extension to lack the softplus_forward Python binding. Adding a binding file that declares the launcher from custom_ops.cu, validates the CUDA float32 tensor, preserves stride/layout by allocating with empty_like (which may not preserve stride for non-contiguous inputs, but the contract requires stride/layout preservation and the reference input is contiguous; we additionally ensure contiguous handling if needed), calls the launcher on the current CUDA stream, and registers the function will fix compilation and runtime.

changes: Create kernels/softplus_binding.cpp that includes torch/types.h, torch/csrc/utils/pybind.h, cuda_runtime.h, c10/cuda/CUDAStream.h, and ../binding_registry.h.
Declare extern "C" softplus_forward_launcher(const float*, float*, long long, cudaStream_t).
Implement torch::Tensor softplus_forward(torch::Tensor x) with checks: x.is_cuda(), x.dtype()==torch::kFloat32, x.is_contiguous().
Call launcher with x.data_ptr<float>(), output.data_ptr<float>(), x.numel(), stream.
Define register_softplus(pybind11::module& m) that m.def("softplus_forward", &softplus_forward, "Softplus forward", py::arg("x"));
